g.text: Generic estimated flask geometries; screening estimates are not measured product performance.
Dashed lines: calibration required or extrapolated. Red rings: extrapolated values. Missing estimates are gaps.
Baffled P/V has no explicit size/orbit term. Transfer uses different material/model families; baffle effects are not isolated.
